name: PAX2 Velocity Classifier
method: L2 logistic regression (lambda 2.0 on standardized features) per horizon on 316 shorts from 39 channels; leave-one-channel-out and a time split at 2026-10-09T19:30:16Z.
target: Hit at 72 hours: views at 72 hours at least 3x the channel median (baselines.json); the training set's settled tier where no 72-hour reading exists
series: running maximum of views, anchored at (0h, 0 views), linear in hours; the 72-hour value is the last reading at or after hour 71.5 (the poller stops at 72.0)

features.label: Views at 1h over the channel median (log10)
